title: Support for glm-4v-9b with mllm_plugin.
bodyExcerpt:
# 🎉 Support for glm-4v-9b with `mllm_plugin`.

Fixes #4375

## 📝 Submission Checklist

- [x] Did you read the [contributor guideline](https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)?
- [x]  **TODO:**  Done eval tests for this PR.(Limited)
- [x]  **TODO:**  Done SFT tests for this PR.

## notes:
* **Eval test:** Some padding issues may encounter due to `self.training` in `modeling_chatglm.py`.
author: marko1616

summary.summaryZh: 新增通过 mllm_plugin 支持 glm-4v-9b，并完成有限的评测测试和 SFT 测试；评测过程中可能因 modeling_chatglm.py 中的 self.training 遇到部分 padding 问题
summary.impactScopeZh: 影响 glm-4v-9b 的 mllm_plugin 使用及相关评测场景。
evidence: 【正文】Some padding issues may encounter due to self.training in modeling_chatglm.py.
